name: Zainab Reyes
headline: Data Engineer
summary: Data engineer and analytics specialist with a track record of building reliable data pipelines, modeling operational data, and supporting decision-making with clear metrics. Experienced across batch and streaming workflows, with hands-on work in Python, SQL, and data platforms that support both reporting and advanced analytics. Comfortable partnering with product and operations teams to improve data quality, latency, and delivery consistency.

roles.title: Junior Data Engineer
bullets: Built Bash and SQL scripts to automate daily ingestion jobs and keep tabular data ready for reporting, reducing manual handling by 40%.
Designed PostgreSQL data modeling patterns for operational datasets and improved query performance for recurring analyses by 28%.
Developed Python transforms that validated source files, standardized records, and prepared features for PyTorch experiments.
Maintained a clean handoff between upstream feeds and the warehouse by documenting load rules and resolving data issues within the backend process.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Orchestrated Python and Airflow workflows to move production metrics through the analytics layer, cutting refresh time by 35%.
Integrated Kafka event streams into SQL tables for near-real-time reporting and improved traceability across 12 core events.
Built PyTorch-assisted checks to flag unusual sensor patterns before they reached dashboards, lowering false alerts by 22%.
Partnered with operations teams to improve data definitions and ensure consistent metric logic across weekly releases.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Designed a more resilient analytics layer with dbt and SQL, aligning business rules to a shared model and reducing rework by 30%.
Built Python and Spark pipelines that processed large-scale usage data and supported Computer vision feature preparation.
Applied R and PyTorch to explore model outputs, compare experiment results, and surface quality gaps in image-based workflows.
Led system design discussions for the data platform, balancing scalability, observability, and dependable delivery for 3 product teams.

roles.title: Senior Data Engineer
bullets: Built end-to-end ETL flows in Python, SQL, BigQuery and Snowflake to unify reporting across finance and operations, improving daily freshness by 50%.
Packaged containerized jobs with Docker and Git so pipeline changes could be reviewed, promoted, and rolled back with less operational risk.
Expanded Spark processing for Computer vision datasets and reduced file handling time by 33% on large batch runs.
Used R, PyTorch and Python to validate model outputs, compare business segments, and support forecast review meetings.
Implemented schema controls and recovery steps across the warehouse environment to keep critical tables stable during high-volume loads.

projects.name: Granite Ledger
projects.description: Built Granite Ledger as a finance analytics project using scikit-learn to score transaction risk and compare model performance across labeled samples.
